versions.changelog:
Local AI Stack 1.0.0 — Turn your Mac into a fully offline AI workstation.

- Install and run local large language models using Ollama and OpenCode with no internet required.
- Curated set of 4 top models (qwen2.5-coder, mistral, gemma3, llama3.2) with a detailed usage and selection guide.
- Step-by-step installation, setup, troubleshooting, and update instructions for macOS.
- Bi-weekly automatic model updates via a simple cron job.
- Designed for privacy, zero API costs, and seamless OpenClaw integration.
